name: Sultans Trail Section 1: Vienna - Bratislava
description_md:
Sultans Trail Section 1: Vienna - Bratislava is a waymarked hiking route located in Austria. It is signposted as ST1 and belongs to the international waymarked hiking network.

The route covers a distance of 106.9 km with 908 m of ascent and 1222 m of descent. The walking time takes about 29 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, and the difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. Nearby places include the route passing Vienna within 100 m, Battle of Vienna within 100 m, and DO&CO Albertina within 200 m.
